decision.name: READER_GREEN_REQUIRES_A_DEFINED_SNAPSHOT_READ_PROTOCOL
decision.new_finding: Exact public 63-entry tree contains writer runner/storage and handoff construction but no versioned multi-artifact snapshot reader/manifest implementation or ANATA_HANDOFF.md document; Capital Flow README references ANATA_HANDOFF.md yet it is absent from this public tree. The pinned Oct14 reader interleave can witness mixed raw files, but a post-fix GREEN cannot be awarded merely because writer P0 serializes or final files agree. Identify an in-scope consumer-facing coherent snapshot protocol first, or classify reader test INCONCLUSIVE/INTERFACE_BLOCKED. This is an interface/acceptance gap, not a witnessed production consumer defect.
no_network_test_contract: At exact SHA run unchanged python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests -rs.
Apply test-only pinned P0 two-writer and P1 POSIX process matrix overlays to disposable checkout, never public branch.

Seed G0 with run_once(network=False,external_jsonl=(),as_of_ms=T0); gate G1 after latest.json replacement; record [T1,T0,T0] raw files as RED source witness only; do not assert a consumer failure without a supported reader.
For reader GREEN, invoke documented in-scope versioned snapshot reader/manifest under the gate; require coherent G0/G1 or explicit fail-closed retry. If absent, label INTERFACE_BLOCKED, not PASS.

Run targeted non-skipped P0/P1/reader pytest and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests -rs; retain exact SHA, stdout/stderr, exit codes, process overlap witness and test-only overlay hashes.
